# Bildup

> Sourced acquisition intelligence for searchers and independent buyers. Bildup surfaces off-market, owner-operated European businesses with real succession signals, ranks them against your acquisition thesis, and traces every signal to its primary source.

## What it is
- A tool for ONE buyer acquiring ONE business: self-funded searchers, search funds, ETA (entrepreneurship through acquisition), independent sponsors, and acquisitive family offices.
- Coverage: lower-mid-market companies across France, the United Kingdom, Germany, Austria, the Netherlands, and Ireland — deep, not wide.
- Verifiability is the product: every signal links to an official document, so any claim can be checked.
- 100% buyer-side: Bildup is never mandated by a seller and never resells your deal flow.
- Beyond sourcing: cross-border build-up / roll-up suggestions, profitability-uplift levers, deep due diligence, and a vetted deal team (M&A lawyer, due diligence, financing, IT modernisation) at negotiated rates — introduced when you need them.

## Primary sources
- Ownership & succession signals: Companies House (UK), BODACC + Infogreffe (France), Handelsregister (Germany), Firmenbuch (Austria), KVK (Netherlands), CRO (Ireland).
- Deal & market activity: CFNEWS.

## How it works
1. Set your acquisition thesis: sectors, geographies, revenue band, keywords.
2. Get a ranked, sourced shortlist of matching targets immediately.
3. Generate a deal brief in which every claim links to its primary document.
4. Track targets through a pipeline: sourced → screening → diligence → term sheet → close.

## Pricing
- Searcher — €299/month (€2,990/year)
- Sponsor — €999/month (€9,990/year)
- Firm — from €1,800/month (sales-assisted, custom contract)
- Searcher and Sponsor are self-serve with a 14-day free trial. No credit card required.
